title: Pisa morning & lunch — reversed city walk, then the flight home
subtitle: Saturday before FR9923 (PSA → EIN, 17:40): morning train to Pisa Centrale, drop bags, a relaxed reversed loop through the centre, pizza at Il Montino for lunch, the Keith Haring mural as the last stop near the station, then PisaMover to the airport ~2 h before departure.
excluded: Baths of Nero (Bagni di Nerone) and everything inside Piazza dei Miracoli (Tower, Duomo, Baptistery) — deliberately skipped again today.

alert.title: Il Montino timing — now comfortable, still confirm
alert.text: Saturday lunch opens 12:30 (their site lists Mon–? lunch 12:30–15:00). The old Monday/Friday plan arrived 25 min before closing; today you sit down at 12:30 with no rush. Call +39 050 598695 to confirm a table for the group at 12:30 and Saturday hours. Airport math with buffers: bags at Centrale by 14:45, PisaMover ~15:00 (every few minutes, ~5 min ride, bags fine on board), at PSA ~15:15 for a 17:40 Fast Track departure — 2 h 25 min of slack for delays.

transfers.text: Lucca → Pisa Centrale, Regionale, ~30 min, roughly every 30 min. Target the ~09:35 departure (validate the ticket at the yellow machines).
If you're coming from Florence instead, SMN → Pisa Centrale is ~1 h — leave by 08:45 for the same timeline.
Pisa Centrale → Galileo Galilei Airport, every few minutes, ~5 min ride. Go with the bags; no need to be back at the station after the mural.

stops.name: Train to Pisa Centrale
stops.note: From Lucca (or Florence, see transfers). Leave any Lucca bags with the host per check-out terms; today's luggage lives in the station lockers.

stops.name: Drop luggage at the station
stops.note: Bag-drop / lockers around Piazza della Stazione. Keep receipts for the ~14:30 pickup on the way to the airport.

stops.name: Walk to Piazza dei Cavalieri
stops.note: Uphill-order stops are now reversed twice — today we start with the sights so pizza lands exactly at 12:30. The scarred tower, the Scavi di Tut photo spot.

stops.name: Piazza dei Cavalieri
stops.note: Palazzo della Carovana facade, quiet afternoon-of-the-morning light.

stops.name: Piazza delle Vettovaglie
stops.note: Old market loggia; espresso at the arcade tables if you need a second.

stops.name: Walk along the Arno
stops.note: Lungarno Mediceo eastward — coloured facades, no bridges needed.

stops.name: Pizza at Pizzeria Il Montino
stops.note: Your own pick since the first planning: pizza, cecina, castagnaccio, filled schiacciate. Via (Vicolo) del Monte 1. Relaxed full hour — this is the last proper meal in Tuscany.

stops.name: Keith Haring — Tuttomondo mural
stops.note: Wall of Chiesa di S. Antonio, Largo Keith Haring, painted 1983. Now it's the finale near the station instead of the mid-afternoon stop.

stops.name: Collect luggage at Centrale
stops.note: Buffer built in; even a slow walk beats the train schedule.

stops.name: PisaMover to Galileo Galilei (PSA)
stops.note: Depart the station concourse level. Arrive ~15:10, bag drop + Fast Track security, gate by 17:10.

stops.name: FR9923 PSA → Eindhoven
stops.note: Booking C2J5JM, seats 09A/09B, Fast Track, Priority & 2 Cabin Bags. Arrive EIN 19:35.
